results.title: The Chilean
results.overview: 1976, Aldo, an explosives expert, is exiled to Italy after mining protests. There he meets Luciana, an anarchist doctor who offers to reunite him with his family, but only if he takes up his old trade: making bombs for revolutionaries.

results.title: Pocong Merah
results.overview: Katiyem, a black magic shaman who was murdered, now she is a Pocong Merah and terrorizes the residents who killed her and looks for sacrifices.

results.title: Duudsonit-elokuva: Kotiinpaluu
results.overview: The Dudesons, aka Jukka Hildén, Jarno Laasala, H-P Parviainen, and Jarno Leppälä, who have been entertaining and inspiring audiences around the world for 25 years, return to their legendary ranch in Southern Ostrobothnia.

results.title: Psycho Side Chick
results.overview: After being dumped by her married lover, a crazed woman fights to win him back and will get rid of anyone who stands in her way.

results.title: Détroit d'Ormuz : la traversée du cargo géant Merete Maerks
results.original_title: Détroit d'Ormuz : la traversée du cargo géant Merete Maerks

results.title: Behind the Screen: Milano Cortina 2026
results.overview: Documentary of the Olympic Broadcasting Services' delivery of the Opening Ceremony through the eyes of the director, Simon Staffruth, to the work of the various departments responsible for bringing the Winter Olympic Games competition action to television channels and digital streaming platforms around the world.

results.title: Lomu
results.overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

results.title: Married to the Filipino Mafia
results.overview: Meet the Filipino Mafia Family.  “Blood is thicker than water. We’re happy to spill yours.”  Marrying into this family? Good luck.

results.title: Klaus Mäkelä Conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 1 Philharmonie de Paris
results.original_title: Klaus Mäkelä Conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 1 Philharmonie de Paris
results.overview: The Orchestre de Paris conducted by star conductor Klaus Mäkelä performs Gustav Mahler’s first symphony, a hymn to nature featuring folk melodies and motifs.

results.title: Due West
results.overview: A small-town woman in need of medical care in West Texas is forced to break the law.

results.title: Сеть
results.overview: How the internet affects each of us. Cybersecurity experts, psychologists, and priests discuss the dangers of immersion in virtual reality and how internet addiction is ruining lives.

results.title: Oye Chill Maar
results.overview: Four close friends face challenges when secrets and troubling events reveal the risks of social media obsession. At the center is Prem, a young man dealing with past difficulties and questions of identity.

results.title: The Banquet
results.overview: With her personal life falling apart, an ad executive is reluctantly pushed by her fiery mother into the one challenge she never thought she’d have to take on: her family’s annual Chuseok (Korean Thanksgiving) celebration.

results.title: Daddy's Little Meatball
results.overview: On a trip to New York, an Australian father and daughter navigate the city and their strained relationship.

results.title: El último recreo
results.overview: Narciso Ibáñez Serrador's masterpiece, Who Can Kill a Child?, turns fifty this year. This documentary traces its origins, explores the locations where it was filmed, speaks with some of the children who appeared in the film for the very first time, and analyzes its importance in the history of horror filmmaking worldwide. A celebration of the legacy of a film that, five decades later, continues to have the same impact.

results.title: Little Miss Sun Sign
results.overview: As the camera orbits him, Joey Frank struggles to convey an idea about astrology to a rotating group of guests. In 2006, in a manic episode in a matinee of Little Miss Sunshine, Joey Frank had an epiphany that he attempts to recreate by watching the film again. 14 hours of stopping and starting gets boiled and trimmed down to 101 minutes, so that Little Miss Sun Sign is the same length and size as the film from whence it came.

results.title: Happy Glasses
results.overview: Happy Glasses are a new product that promise to end depression by making the user only see the bright side of life. However, two siblings find that such promises always come with a price.
